description: If you’re looking to learn to get into a handstand, this 15-minute, no-equipment-needed class will introduce you to jumping into a tuck handstand. You can practice this anywhere to build your balance!

All you need is a single bar and a pair of rings to create mobility in the shoulders through hanging, twisting, and pulling. This 10-minute follow-along is the perfect addition to any upper body strength training–use it for warm up, cool down, or on a recovery day to keep your shoulders happy!
Build your pulling power and sculpt your core with this fun and challenging workout! You’ll build strength for a stellar rope climb while also developing control over your midsection.

Knee pain is NOT inevitable! In 15 minutes you can strengthen the muscles, tendons, and ligaments of the knees, significantly decrease your injury risk, and improve your knee health. Prepare your knees for the unexpected twists and turns of life using this series—you’ll be happy that you did!
Have less than five minutes to spare? You can still fit in this fiery core routine! Have a bit more time? Consider completing a few rounds for a real burner!
This 25-minute warm-up will create heat in your body from head to toe, while focusing on active and engaging stretches to increase your flexibility while getting you fired up!

This 5-minute routine will loosen your muscles, increase blood flow to your joints, prepare your body for exercise, and aid in recovery. Say goodbye to stiff, locked up limbs and crackly joints–embrace this seriously healthy habit for impressive mobility!
A short but powerful 4-minute routine that can be done at home daily to light up your entire core! Expect to work hard in this no-excuse sequence for solid abs.

Swing, swivel, and lean your way to healthy movement with this gentle mobility routine! Create warmth through the back, chest, shoulders, and hips to boost blood flow and energize the body during this sequence.

Follow along for 30 minutes to lengthen and strengthen your legs from hip to toe! Strength building exercises create muscle and tone throughout the legs, while active limbering movements stretch and relieve tight muscles.

Test your core endurance with this 25-minute workout focused on longer holds and full abdominal engagement. Hollow Body and Arch Body Holds may be the main event, but you’ll feel the heat from head to toe!
Get upside down with this 20-minute handstand workout! First, we’ll focus on prepping key areas, including the shoulders and wrists, before we practice body positions inverted on the wall.

A powerful core curriculum so effective that washboard abs are just a side note. Strength and stability here transfers to better movement throughout the body. Your entire core will be conditioned so far beyond traditional crunches you’ll never consider going back!

Everyone can start building the mobility necessary for the middle splits and pancake–no matter what your flexibility level is! This 45-minute sequence will help you find relief and develop flexibility throughout your lower body.

17 potent leg strengthening exercises intertwined with hip, knee, and ankle mobility, take you from introductory squatting, all the way to single-leg pistol squats and advanced weighted leg strength. We don’t recommend performing any weighted leg work until you’ve reached the advanced level of this progression plan.

A perfect 45-minute mobility routine for athletes and office workers alike! Tension in the quads, hip flexors, feet, calves, and hamstrings will rapidly disappear with continued use of this sequence. If Front Splits are your goal, start here!

The best of both worlds: push, pull, and planche your way to unrivaled levels of strength while mobilizing and preventing injury. 150 progressions will take you as far you want to go, whether that’s tight and toned or massive and muscular.

Fight the negative effects of sitting by opening up your shoulders and thoracic spine during this 45-minute guided stretch session. Steadily build towards a full thoracic bridge while creating health throughout your shoulders and upper back.
More than 25 handstand exercises, each with accompanying mobility drills, to take you from basic inversions to a perfect handstand line. Indestructible wrists, and bulletproof shoulders included.

The most important and functional of all the GymnasticBodies training components. This series starts off with quadrupedal exercises and gentle tumbling, including basic rolling skills, and moves into swinging, travelling, plyometric, and ballistic movements as you’re ready. Dynamic strength training is THE essential tool for transferring maximal strength into athletically usable power.

10-minute sequences crafted to gently relieve tension in every area of your body. Use them to safely introduce stretching and prepare especially tight regions for focused mobilization and injury prevention.

In less than five minutes you can strengthen your wrists to prevent injury and properly prepare for wrist-intense workouts–like handstand or planche training. These often-overlooked but seriously vital joints should make an appearance in any warm-up, and this follow-along makes it simple.

Looking for fresh ways to incorporate stall bars into your fitness routine? This 10-minute follow-along introduces six stall bar stretches that target and ignite the hamstrings, hips and thoracic spine.
Test your core strength with this challenging 5-minute workout! This routine progressively increases the intensity of two classic positions, the arch and hollow, to deliver a big abdominal burn.

Hit the hamstrings and quads while getting a "killer" leg pump with this quick but challenging routine. Get a powerful start with jumping lunges, before moving into targeted mobilities and finishing with a straddle-L hold in this 5-minute workout.

A 20-day introduction to Gymnastic Strength Training (GST). Learn basic body positions and explore ranges of motion uncommon in conventional workout programs. You’ll leave the course with the skills and confidence to succeed with moderate level GST workouts.

Purpose of Movements

These are not a pass/fail exam.

These movements have been selected to highlight mobility deficits which currently exist in your physical structure. By identifying these deficits we can then begin to take progressive action towards their resolution.

The expectations are most certainly not for you to be able to hit the ground running and perform these perfectly on your first day. That would be beyond unreasonable. For now simply explore and experiment with these movements. Do not attempt to force anything. Do not attempt to force perfection if you are not currently physically prepared to do so.
Rather note the areas in which you are tight and struggling, keep them in the forefront of your thoughts and we'll begin to gradually correct these deficiencies with patience and consistency.

Intro: Elements 1 is the first of a six part series to build basic strength and mobility. Within Elements, you will find 15-20 minute, easy-to-follow workouts that are doable for everyone! Create a fitness base and learn body control with movements like scapular shrugs to improve your shoulder range and tuck hollow body holds to ignite your core.

How to use: Elements 1 consists of five upper body and five lower body (which includes core) milestones. Work through these milestones at your own pace until you can comfortably complete the hardest (5th) workouts. You'll then be ready to move on to Elements 2.
Begin learning to hold a handstand with this fun 30 day challenge. Each day will work a new variation to keep your training fresh and invigorating.

Skipping your warm up should be out of the question, but if you want to hit the important points in seven minutes, this one will do the trick. Warm up and stretch all of your biggest muscle groups and be ready to jump into your strength work.

Kicking into a handstand is just the beginning. Learn how to control your 'stand form from its base by testing your tuck. Tucks will show you if you're stabilized from your fingertips to your shoulders and whether your hips are really stacked. And tucks never lie.
Limber up your legs and hips with this 30-minute follow-along flexibility sequence. Through static and active stretches, you’ll limber and lengthen the muscles of your lower body.
Fast track your mobility progress by adding load to this 15-minute weighted full-body routine. Give special attention to the areas that need it most, including your wrists, neck, shoulders, and hips!
Strengthen and mobilize your joints to prevent common injuries. Bands classes will teach you how to use this valuable tool as part of a balanced workout routine.

After some much-needed limbering, fire up your core with body levers before transitioning to leg-strengthening squat variations. Top off this 40-minute burn with upper body endurance via wall-supported handstand conditioning and close it all out with focused flexibility practice.
If you’re looking to squeeze in a quick 15 minute workout and still condition everything, this circuit will hit the spot. It includes a quick warm-up and cool-down.

Intro: Continue progressively overloading your workouts to steadily gain strength and muscle in this series of 15-30 minute follow-alongs. You’ll find many exercises, such as V-Ups, target multiple body parts, like your hips and core. Creating these connections helps you link these positions to the more advanced progressions to come!

How to use: Elements 3 consists of five upper body and five lower body (which includes core) milestones. Work through these milestones at your own pace until you can comfortably complete the hardest (5th) workouts. You'll then be ready to move on to Elements 4.

Keep your heart rate high as you warm-up with this 6-minute full-body class. This HIIT warm up covers all areas of the body with lunges, squats, core and upper body exercises coupled with high knees. You’ll be ready to take on your GST workout after this follow-along.

If a quick, full-body burn is what you’re after, you’ll find it here as you move quickly between exercises that target your upper body, core, and legs. Use this warmup to raise your heart rate and prepare your muscles and joints for your GST workout, or use it on it’s own to sneak in a HIIT movement session.

Get a full body stretch using parallettes as a tool to support your best positions and move a little deeper. Use this 12-minute class to cool down after a strength session, or to supplement your stretching routine.

Follow along as you incorporate parallettes into your conditioning through sliding, pressing, and dipping. Expect to work hard for the duration of this 7-minute class. Add it in to kickstart your conditioning days by increasing your heart rate and activating the muscles of your upper body.
Follow along with this prehab routine used weekly by Coach Sommer’s athletes to keep your shoulders healthy and strong. All it requires is a couple light dumbbells and a set of rings.

Learning bodyline is important to training handstand correctly. You can use this class to get very familiar with two positions: anterior and posterior pelvic tilt. These key positions are the backbone for effective core and upper body exercises. Use this class until these positions are second nature for you. This will make the rest of your training more effective because you will be able to easily find and keep proper form.

Intro: Graduate from the floor in your core workout as you progress into hanging leg lift and arch-up variations, and trade in all the push-ups for some dipping strength gains! In these 10-30 minute sequences, you’ll start to really see and feel the results of the consistent work you’ve put in.

How to use: Elements 4 consists of five upper body and five lower body (which includes core) milestones. Work through these milestones at your own pace until you can comfortably complete the hardest (5th) workouts. You'll then be ready to move on to Elements 5.

Keep your hips healthy and strong while protecting against common injuries, aches, and pains. This short follow along moves your hips through their whole range of motion and creates strength through the whole range. All this is done through simple, standing leg raise variations that can be done anywhere. Use this class to prime your hips for squatting or other lower-body exercises, or as part of a longer mobility session.

Intro: You’ll start to see the carryover of these movements to more advanced bodyweight skills. The line you create in your hollow body is the same one you’ll need for your front lever, same goes for the planche lean holds in relation to your planche. You may still have a ways to go before you reach these final positions, but feel accomplished as you bridge the gap into intermediate training!.

How to use: Elements 5 consists of five upper body and five lower body (which includes core) milestones. Work through these milestones at your own pace until you can comfortably complete the hardest (5th) workouts. You'll then be ready to move on to Elements 6.

Continue to develop posterior and anterior pelvic tilt through 9 minutes of drills done in wall-supported handstand positions. Learning to find the correct alignment while inverted transfers seamlessly to your handstand training. You’ll need to be comfortable with these positions to correct your balance and find your stack in a handstand.

Enjoy a fresh take on core training during this 20-minute routine. You’ll complete a comprehensive core workout including arch-hollow rolls, arch-up variations, and leg lifts alongside several other movements. Your lower and upper abs, as well as your obliques and low back muscles will feel stronger than ever as you implement this core workout. Use it as a stand alone workout and consider following up with a full body mobility session.

Use stall bars to find relief through deep stretches in your upper and lower body. You’ll weight your straddle and pike stretches by hanging on the stall bars. You’ll also stretch your shoulders using the stall bars to go deeper. This 6-minute class is perfect for those days when you’re feeling frozen and locked up. Use it to loosen up before your workout or to shake out tension after!

By now you’ve built awareness, control, and strength in your body that will transfer seamlessly into more advanced movement (like that found in Foundation 2!). You’ll reach the full expression of basic bodyweight dips, and gain unshakeable core endurance through full hollow body rocks. Congratulations on sticking through to the end of the beginning of your GST journey!

Keeping your elbows healthy means better movement for both your straight and bent arm training. Taking care of these important joints is made simple with this 10-minute prehab sequence. Using just a light weight, or even a PVC pipe,  you’ll protect your elbows and prepare them to stay healthy and strong for strength training. Do this sequence as part of your upper body warm-up, or as an addition to your focused mobility training.

The Calf Sequence is perfect for students who are ready to increase the volume of prehab work for their ankle and calf muscles. Challenge yourself with 150 reps for three different variations of calf raises. Can you complete each without resting?   Note: This sequence is a progression from the 60r calf work found in the Front Split Series.
